name: Ashfaque Thonikkadavan
title: Data Scientist — Forecasting, Optimization & Applied ML
heroRole: I build forecasting and optimization systems that turn data into operational decisions.
bio: Data Scientist working on forecasting, optimization and applied machine learning. A PhD-trained researcher building end-to-end systems for demand planning, inventory and constrained decision-making
aboutLong: I'm a PhD-trained researcher working at the intersection of forecasting, optimization and applied machine learning. During my PhD at the University of Strasbourg, I worked with large-scale numerical simulations and built Python pipelines to turn high-dimensional scientific data into interpretable results. I now apply the same quantitative approach to operational problems such as demand forecasting, inventory planning and constrained resource allocation.
